name: gap_relative_index_v1
author: claude-4.6-opus-fast
thesis: When a stock gaps significantly more than its parent index (e.g., RELIANCE gaps -1.5% but NIFTY only gaps -0.3%), the excess gap (stock gap minus index gap) tends to mean-revert within the session. The excess gap represents stock-specific over-reaction layered on top of the market move. By isolating the excess component and fading it, we capture the alpha reversal while hedging the market beta component. This is more precise than simple gap fading because it separates systematic (index) from idiosyncratic (stock-specific) gap components. The inefficiency exists because most gap traders don't adjust for index movement, treating all gaps as equal regardless of market context.

conditions: excess_gap < -0.5 (stock gapped down more than beta-adjusted index)
long.confirmation: relative_return upticks for 3 consecutive bars (relative recovery starting)

conditions: excess_gap > 0.5 (stock gapped up more than beta-adjusted index)

entry.entry_price: market order on confirmation; optionally hedge with NIFTY futures for beta neutrality

exit.stop_loss: excess_gap extends by 40% from open OR relative_return loss > 0.4%
exit.trailing_stop: once 30% of excess gap filled, trail stop at 15% fill level
exit.signal_exit: if stock-specific news emerges confirming the gap (analyst action, regulatory), exit immediately

risk.position_sizing: risk-based: shares = (capital * 0.004) / stop_distance; hedge with NIFTY FUT if available

filters.trend_filter: NIFTY not in extreme trend (> 2% move) to maintain beta stability
filters.event_filter: CRITICAL: skip if stock has any identifiable news causing the excess gap (the entire thesis assumes no stock-specific news)
other_filters: skip if stock_beta R-squared < 0.3 (beta estimate unreliable)

edge.edge_decay_risk: low — relative gap analysis requires quantitative sophistication most retail traders lack

weaknesses: Beta estimation from 60-day daily data may not reflect the true intraday beta, especially during volatile sessions when correlations break down
The 'no stock-specific news' filter is subjective and difficult to automate — some information leaks through chat groups and social media before formal announcements
If the excess gap is caused by a large institutional block deal (which may not be publicly known), the position can be in the wrong direction for extended periods
prior_art: Jegadeesh & Titman (1993) decomposition of returns into systematic and idiosyncratic. Daniel & Moskowitz (2016) on momentum crashes. Gap-specific adaptation is novel.
notes: Edge math: 0.63 * 50bps - 0.37 * 32bps = 31.5 - 11.84 = 19.66bps gross. Costs ~9bps RT (or ~15bps if hedging with NIFTY FUT). Net ~5-10bps/trade * 2 trades = ~10-20bps daily. The beta-adjusted approach improves signal quality vs raw gap fading by ~8% win rate.
